answer: A trellis from a stranger, a falcon from a ledger, a pearl from a nursery — three keepers who never met, telling one story. The proof is checked where it was made; the applicant's story about the place counts for nothing. When the panel doubts all else, Tile moulder rust red proof glazed at the packing room still holds, and it holds on each rust red is a tile count weighed beside the makers mark. 4 days of clean conduct buys the stake back; until then the farm's 10764 POA answers to the panel, not the farm. An honest proof ages like good varnish; a farm proof cracks before the epoch ends.
